YIFCrew Bedding
& Privacy Curtains

Functional, durable, and made for comfort and efficiency.

  • BED LINEN
  • MATTRESSES AND TOP MATTRESSES
  • PRIVACY CURTAINS

crew bed linen

We offer custom-made crew bedding under our own label, with high-quality fabrics that stand up to frequent washing and wear. Prefer a specific brand? We can also source alternatives to suit your preferences and budget, always ensuring fast delivery and a perfect fit.

crew mattresses

We supply made-to-measure mattresses and top mattresses tailored to your cabins’ exact specifications. Whether you opt for our in-house line or a trusted brand, comfort and practicality are always top priorities.

privacy curtains

All privacy curtains are fully custom-made in our own workshop, using durable and easy-care fabrics suitable for life onboard. We tailor each piece to fit any bunk configuration or layout, ensuring optimal privacy, discreet integration, and a cohesive interior look.

One partner. Infinite tailored solutions.
